name: Nick Fox
source: The narrator of part 1 (taking place in 1987). A boy who has lived in Alcantra his entire life and will be a senior in high school the upcoming school year. Kind and considerate, he tries to understand the viewpoints of others and has an idealistic side. He becomes friends with Alexandria after meeting her at the Summer Festival. They get along well, though Nick tends to be on the receiving end of Alexandria’s verbal jabs. Fortunately, he’s kind of into that.
